title: Mixed Event — You Are My Hero! — Episode5 Begin Preparations!

meta.Event Outline: On one of his runs, Tsukasa rescues and befriends a stranded cat. At the same time, a cat-themed carnival has arrived in Shibuya.

rows.Line: A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I believe we all have a copy of the script.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, it's bound and everything...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really feels like we're getting ready to do a show now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for asking you both to also appear in the show. I know you're very busy fixing the costumes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not a problem! I'm actually really happy about getting to do a show with you again, Tsukasa. I mean, the one we did at the chocolate factory was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Momoi, are you going to be okay? You also have your group to think about...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that won't be an issue.
The others gave me the green light after I told them about Mr. Inuyama.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They told me to go out there and do my best since they understand what I want to do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start going over the story!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's based on the synopsis Mr. Inuyama gave us the other day, right? A feline hero protects a carnival...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It takes place at a carnival which has a large Ferris wheel as its main attraction...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The story revolves around our hero, Nyantaro, taking part in an epic battle against a pair of mischievous cat sisters.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: An epic battle? I don't remember it being quite so dramatic...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The sisters showed up at the carnival one day and began pulling pranks on all the guests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nyantaro brought them to justice each time, but that did nothing to deter them from coming back time and again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, one day, the sisters come up with the most dastardly plan imaginable...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They stop the Ferris wheel, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and it saddens many of the guests since it's the carnival's main attraction.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When the sisters run off with the control switch, Nyantaro gives chase in order to get the carnival guests smiling once more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The sisters are quick, and they don't make it easy, but Nyantaro does manage to catch them and reactivate the Ferris wheel.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The sisters finally see the error of their ways, and the guests return to smiling. The end!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man, the climax sounds really exciting!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I can't wait to see how Nyantaro chases after those sisters!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, by the way, Mr. Inuyama played the lead during his carnival's opening celebration.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on a second... Do you think the Nyantaro in this show is based off the real Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, they apparently put on this show around twenty years ago...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means Nyantaro was named after the hero from this story.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
In other words, he's the embodiment of some really precious memories.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama must've loved this show a lot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
And that's a powerful source of motivation!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Definitely! We've gotta make this the best show ever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do our best!
What do you need us to do next, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, we need to decide roles now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Starting with Nyantaro.
Several minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we all have our roles now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The protagonist, Nyantaro, will be played by... Me, Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As for the cat sisters, Airi will play the older one and Kusanagi will play the younger one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to working with you, Kusanagi! I can't wait for you to teach me more about acting like you did during Shibu Schools Fest!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm also looking forward to working with you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you'll be playing one of the carnival's guests, Akiyama. Although, it is a tad unfortunate that you're going to be all by yourself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My plan's to pull out all the stops and really act out having a fun day, but I feel like I can only do so much on my own...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
If only we had at least one more person.
Isn't there anyone we can ask...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good question.
Unfortunately, Rui and Emu are busy that day, and I'm not sure who else could help us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, I think I know just the person to ask...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When I told the others in my group about this, Minori's eyes lit up and she said, “Doing a show with them sounds like so much fun!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She even said that she wants to help out in any way she can, so we could have her join the cast.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Hanasato, you say?!
She's sort of my dance student...
It'd be great to have her on board!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'd also love to work with Minori!
If anything, I should be the one asking her to join us since she's my favorite idol...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'll try asking her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe. This is gonna be so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That should take care of our casting problem. What else do we need to check up on...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, how are the costumes coming along? I've been fixing the accessories and stuff bit by bit...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm working on the hero's costume right now. It was pretty beat up, but I should be able to get it back in shape!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As for the sisters, their cat ears and a couple other accessories were all that was left. We sorta have to use clothes you and Kusanagi already have for the outfits.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To compensate, I'm gonna make everything look really cute by attaching a bunch of ribbons and stuff! So, stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can't wait to see what you make!
Also, we should meet up to work on costume stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'm glad to hear that we all seem to know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. But we only have a week and change until the final day...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know. How about a toast to celebrate us entering the preparation phase of our show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, does that need a toast...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! We need to keep ourselves motivated!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I already finished my drink...
But still, it might be a good way to help us feel more like a team.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do it♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, raise your glasses, you three.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This may be a short show, but we don't have much time to practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As challenging as this endeavor is going to be, let's make sure our show puts smiles on the faces of Mr. Inuyama and all the guests! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Mizuki & Nene
rows.Line: Cheers!
